decisions.reason: The cobot loading system was launched only in 2024 and fits the firm's announced automation direction, so management will keep it and treat any slow uptake as an early-market effect.

The dual-table loading system is a recent automation add-on to the core milling machines that cost little to sustain, so after so short a time on the market management will persist with it and its investment.
The dispensing machine has its own page and a publicly touted Red Dot Design Award, which makes it a highly visible commitment that management will defend and continue.
